# Stepan Kukharskiy

> Architect, computational designer and founder. I build systems that turn AI output into structured, editable work.

This is Stepan Kukharskiy's personal website. It covers independent projects, practical AI experiments and teaching. He has worked with parametric design since 2010 and co-founded SA lab.

His current AI Work series tests which real professional routines AI can do and turns successful procedures into reusable Skills. The goal is 100 tested jobs; one experiment is currently published. New experiments are shared on his LinkedIn profile.

Relay, Spellshape / Live OBJ and Drawing Analysis Engine have separate scopes. Proposed integrations are directions to test, not shipped end-to-end features. The Chrome extension's portable Skill and saved-work flow does not require Relay Desktop.

## Expanded overview

- [Expanded site overview](https://stepankukharskiy.com/llms-full.txt): Project descriptions, Chrome extension flow, experiment results and limitations, teaching and contact links in one text document.

## Canonical pages

- [About Stepan](https://stepankukharskiy.com/): Background and the thesis of structured, editable AI work.
- [Projects](https://stepankukharskiy.com/projects): Relay, Spellshape / Live OBJ and Drawing Analysis Engine, with technical sources.
- [Relay for Chrome](https://stepankukharskiy.com/relay/chrome): Select text in ChatGPT, choose Turn into Skill or Save work, review and download, then continue in Codex or another AI chat.
- [AI Work](https://stepankukharskiy.com/ai-work): Practical experiments with real inputs, checked outputs and explicit limitations.
- [Excel to PowerPoint experiment](https://stepankukharskiy.com/ai-work/excel-to-powerpoint-automation): A prepared six-slide monthly report update with 31 checked numeric targets, three editable charts and a missing explanation left for human review.
- [Teaching](https://stepankukharskiy.com/teaching): Selected workshops and research from 2013 to 2026, including eCAADe, DigitalFUTURES and DesignMorphine, with dated roles and original sources.

## Project resources

- [Relay website](https://task-relay-website-production.up.railway.app): Portable Skills, jobs and retained work.
- [Relay Skills](https://task-relay-website-production.up.railway.app/skills): Executable procedures and worked examples.
- [Relay source](https://github.com/StepanKukharskiy/task-relay): Technical source for Task Relay.
- [Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/task-relay/alicbjedflapdighdmadgbopahfhbgbd): Official Task Relay Chrome Web Store listing.
- [Spellshape](https://spellshape.com): AI-native geometry authoring built around Live OBJ.
- [Live OBJ](https://github.com/StepanKukharskiy/live-obj): OBJ mesh geometry with semantic and procedural metadata for compatible tools.
- [Drawing Analysis Engine](https://github.com/StepanKukharskiy/drawing-analysis-engine): PDF drawing evidence and inspectable analysis; running it does not grant engineer approval.
- [SA lab](https://salab.org/eng): Computational architecture and digital fabrication.
